_comment: Grants no capability, and that is deliberate (Jonah, 2026-09-07): what the seismograph does, it does on its OWN screen rather than by unlocking a line on the desk's. It is still an implement, because a study is furnished by what is standing in it and the page limit counts distinct implements -- so owning one lets you write a longer book, the same as any other piece of the workshop.
